name: KILL.THE.FRIDGE - Shoot, Upgrade, Repeat
detailed_description:
F.R.I.D.G.E. NEEDS TO BE DESTROYED

We are in endgame now. Frosty Reactive Invincible Defense & Guardian Engine is here. And only you can stand in it's way. We have to open that fridge's door and see what's inside. The fate of the world depends on whether you have the ability to click on your mouse enough or not.

1 DAMAGE  = $ 1

Click to shoot. Gain money equal to your damage. As you upgrade your weapons, while dealing more damage, you also gain more money with each shot. With money increase your critical chance, fire rate, reload speed, damage and more.

DISCOVER UNIQUE WEAPONS

Are you bored of same old weapons you've seen a million times before? Do you want to see unique weapons in games? You are in luck then, you magnificent son of a gun. We got bananas, emoji launchers, heterosexual guns, LGBT+ guns, and many more that awaits you to be unlocked.

PASSIVE DAMAGE & INCOME

Set up turrets of your upgraded weapons. These turrets will help you to generate damage passively, meaning you can earn money while you are idle.

UNLOCK POWERFUL SKILLS

Increase your fire rate, infinite ammo, double your damage and many more spells to cast. Unlock all of them to unleash your power.

short_description: The Idle Shooter Clicker you didn’t know you needed. Fire away, earn cash based on your damage, and build a massive passive damage and income system. Upgrade and unlock unique, overpowered weapons to face the ultimate horrifying antagonist. Can you... "KILL.THE.FRIDGE" ?
